F-CUSTODY.scope: Custody binds contract_file, implementation_tree, trial_plan and manifest only. Custody binds no file under experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/.
F-CUSTODY.trial_plan_rule: trial_plan records successor_contract_sha256 at launch. The run recomputes it at launch and at every stage boundary; mismatch is evidence-integrity failure and stops immediately.
F-CUSTODY.manifest_rule: manifest records dirty_summary, launch commit, implementation snapshot task and commit, successor_contract_sha256, tool versions, third-party distributions and the inference block. Launch is refused if dirty_summary lists contract_file or any path under implementation_tree. A dirty_summary line naming any other path is recorded and refuses nothing.
F-CUSTODY.admission_item_successor_hash: Admission requires successor_contract_sha256 in trial_plan to equal the sha256 of contract_file at the launch commit.
F-CUSTODY.invalidation_after_approval: Any edit of contract_file after approval is evidence-integrity failure.
F-CUSTODY.independence: No gate, stop, launch refusal, admission item, validity rule, invalidation rule or outcome depends on the bytes, hash or git status of any file under experiments/EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d/. No run-time procedure opens those paths.

surfaces.F-REV: This contract is never rewritten in place and no amendment layers it. Any change, including one a review requires, is a new successor contract under a new EXP id that states every rule once. This is the only revision rule.
execution_admission_explicitly_not_requi: Verified snapshot archive of EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d approval chain.
Clean or dirty status of any EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d amendment file.
Predecessor governing-text hashes of the held four-layer stack.
surfaces.D10_rule: This contract is never rewritten in place. Any change is a new successor contract under a new EXP id per F-REV. The run uses NEW modules under experiments/EXP-AUXIN-92dccc/implementation/typed/ and edits no implementation file of any other experiment.
